missing_methods.intent: Assert tell your experience text is truncated
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: This method should retrieve the current text from the tell your experience input field using get_entered_text(), get the character count display using get_feedback_text_char_count(), and assert that: 1) The actual text length does not exceed the expected maximum length (e.g., 1000 characters), 2) The character count display shows the correct truncated length, 3) Any text beyond the maximum length has been truncated. The method should return True if text is properly truncated, False otherwise, and raise an assertion error with details if truncation validation fails.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'edit_feedback' element to be present using self.driver.wait_for_object('edit_feedback')
Call existing method self.get_entered_text() to retrieve the current text value from the feedback input field
Store the retrieved text in a variable (e.g., actual_text)
Calculate the actual character length using len(actual_text)
Wait for 'edit_feedback_char_count' element to be present using self.driver.wait_for_object('edit_feedback_char_count')
Call existing method self.get_feedback_text_char_count() to retrieve the character count display text
Parse the character count display text to extract the current count (e.g., from '1000/1000' format)
Assert that len(actual_text) does not exceed expected_max_length parameter
Assert that len(actual_text) equals the parsed current count from the character count display
Assert that the character count display shows the correct format (e.g., '{current}/{max}')
If any assertion fails, raise AssertionError with descriptive message including actual length, expected max length, and character count display value
Return True if all assertions pass
